text:
vikram: heads up — we need to align on the new reliability surface for console dashboards. want to capture timeouts, 5xx by component, OOMs, and degraded-mode/fallback counts across runtime + infra. can we sync on metric names and tags? (cc @tess @jamie @olga)

Tess: +1. for quotas/rate buckets, do we expose per-route QPS buckets or keep at model/pool-level? prefer coarse buckets first.

jamie: recommend both: pool-level for cost dashboards, route-level for incident triage. metric dims: `component`, `route`, `model_variant`, `region`, `fallback_type`.

olga: console needs a stable API: what are the canonical metric names? we can't keep rewriting dashboards. propose a contract doc.

devon: important to define "degraded_mode" — is that any fallback, or only when latency > SLO? we also need `fallback_count` and `fallback_success_rate`.

jamie: agree. my proposal:
```
redwood_runtime_errors_total{error=\"timeout\"}
redwood_runtime_errors_total{error=\"5xx\", component=\"frontend|runtime|model\"}
redwood_runtime_ooms_total
redwood_runtime_degraded_count{degraded_type=\"prefill_fallback|model_swap|graceful_degrade\"}
```
keep units as counts; expose `_rate` via query layer.

Tess: also add `request_path` dimension? could be high-cardinality. maybe sample or top-N only.

olga: we can accept high-cardinality in the telemetry ingest if we set cardinality limits and top-k in console. need a schema: which labels are primary vs optional.

vikram: sounds good. action items: jamie to draft metric contract, devon to define degraded modes + annotated examples, olga to draft console ingestion limits/behavior, tess to propose rate-bucket aggregation strategy. sync friday 10am?

deploy-bot: new branch `telemetry/metrics-contract` deployed to staging at 2146001250 :rocket:

jamie: i'll drop a PR with the proto and example queries. example fallback panel query:
```
sum by(component) (increase(redwood_runtime_degraded_count[5m]))
```
we should also add a vanity panel for SLO-violations: `increase(redwood_request_latency{p95>250}[5m])` — need to convert to proper histogram queries.

devon: for OOMs, runtime emits both `oom_killed` and `oom_action_taken`. we should unify to `redwood_runtime_ooms_total{action=\"killed|restarted\"}`. ops: retention for OOM traces should be 30d minimum.

Tess: for quotas, i'll sketch buckets: <10r/s, 10-100, 100-1000, >1000 and map routes to buckets in routing policy. console will show per-bucket cost and errors.

olga: console will enforce label whitelist `component,region,route,model_variant,fallback_type,quota_bucket`. anything else gets folded to `other`.

vikram: great. can each owner post a short doc in #eng-platform by EOD thurs? then we run the friday sync. thanks :pray:

jamie: :thumbsup: will do.
